# aether_registry (Resource)

The container registry of the provider's organization (one per organization). Creating this resource enables the registry and mints its default robot credential; `robot_username` and `robot_secret` are returned by the API only by that enable call. Credentials rotate in the portal, not through this resource. Destroying this resource disables the registry. Without `purge_on_destroy` the images remain in the platform's project and are restored by a later enable; with it EVERY repository is deleted first (irreversible). Disabling also deletes EVERY robot account of the organization, including `aether_registry_robot_account` resources (they are recreated on the next apply) — order destroys with `depends_on` from the robot accounts to the registry. Cleanup policies are not affected.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Destroying the registry disables it and deletes EVERY robot account of the organization;
# images are kept unless purge_on_destroy = true (irreversible).
resource "aether_registry" "this" {
  purge_on_destroy = false
}

# depends_on makes Terraform destroy the robot account before the registry.
resource "aether_registry_robot_account" "ci" {
  name        = "ci"
  permissions = ["push", "pull"]

  depends_on = [aether_registry.this]
}

# An enabled nightly/weekly "delete" policy runs within about a minute of the apply:
# start with action = "protect" or enabled = false.
resource "aether_registry_cleanup_policy" "old_untagged" {
  name     = "old-untagged"
  action   = "protect"
  schedule = "nightly"
  enabled  = false

  conditions = [
    { type = "untagged", value = "true" },
    { type = "age", op = "gt", value = "30d" },
  ]

  depends_on = [aether_registry.this]
}

output "robot_secret" {
  value     = aether_registry_robot_account.ci.secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `purge_on_destroy` (Boolean) When `true`, destroying this resource deletes EVERY repository of the registry first (irreversible). Defaults to `false`: the images stay in the platform's project and are restored by a later enable. Changing it alone calls no API.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Always `true` while the resource exists (a disabled registry is removed from state).
- `endpoint` (String) Push/pull prefix: `<registry host>/<harbor_project>`.
- `harbor_project` (String) The organization's registry project (`aether-<organization slug>`).
- `id` (String) Registry UUID.
- `quota_gb` (Number) Storage quota in GB; informational; not enforced by the platform today.
- `robot_secret` (String, Sensitive) The default robot's secret. Known only from the enable call; import/adopt leaves them null (`robot_username` and `robot_secret`), and a refresh nulls them (with a warning) when the registry was disabled and re-enabled outside Terraform. Credentials rotate in the portal, not through this resource.
- `robot_username` (String) The default robot's `docker login` username. Known only from the enable call; import/adopt leaves them null (`robot_username` and `robot_secret`), and a refresh nulls them (with a warning) when the registry was disabled and re-enabled outside Terraform.
- `updated_at` (String) Time the registry was last written (RFC 3339); no route updates a registry.
